A '''workshop''' located in the [[Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine]] was used for the construction of [[gaderffii stick]]s by a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of [[Tusken Raider]]s. Overseen by a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider craftsman|craftsman]], it was an open-air area that sat next to the remains of an old [[starship]]. A rug strung from the [[hull]] of the ship provided shade for the craftsman and his students to work with the various tools needed to create a gaffi stick. The former [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] came to the workshop to craft his own stick after earning his place within the tribe.<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" />

==Behind the scenes==
The workshop appeared in "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]," the second episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''. The episode was directed by [[Steph Green]], with production design from [[Andrew L. Jones]] and [[Doug Chiang]],<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" /> and aired on [[January 5]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release date">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}}</ref>
